fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-01-27, Bharathi Raman was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Arasu Nagar Residential Colony in Madurai after a dispute over a boundary issue. The time of the incident was given as 23:50 on 2026-01-27. Vasanth Chandran (9000000408) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Kannan Shankar, using the number 9000000415.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
